title: nameplates
summary: MSUI draws overhead unit names with the core of Benilla's law, and cites it: the height-scale formula (d>4 ? d/4*1.5*0.2 : 0.2) projected as a true world pitch so distance shrinks names, reaction coloring shared with the selection-ring palette, the show gates (own name on, dead creatures only via the target rescue, players/NPCs on), plus the separate enemy V-plate layer whose last-frame rects feed the shared hover/selection pick. Several byte-verified aspects of the reference presentation are missing.

openItems.text: Names are drawn on the ImGui background draw list, not depth-tested world geometry - walls do not occlude overhead names, where the reference's name batch is depth-test ON
NPC subname line missing: the creature-query subname (<Stable Master>) is cached but the overhead block renders only the name line
Player AFK/DND/GM prefixes from PLAYER_FLAGS (<AFK><DND><GM> concatenated before the name) are not rendered
The combat-flash red-orange pulse (first-priority branch of the shared color selector) is applied to the selection ring but not to the overhead name color
